entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... *sigh*... I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I was so excited to get it, but I think I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed.

Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Before we do that, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?
It's just... it's really hard to use. The app interface is so confusing, and I can't seem to find the data I'm looking for. I've read the user manual from front to back, but it doesn't help.
Honestly, I just expected more for the price. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for this. I really needed this money, and I just feel like I wasted it.

I completely understand your frustration. It's important that our products are intuitive and useful. Let me pull up your account information so I can check on the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 34 days ago. Let me just confirm our return policy...

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely go ahead and cannot offer a refund for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now.
Oh, really? Wow, that's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I was just stuck with it. You've really helped me out today.

Of course, I'm happy I could resolve this for you. The email with the shipping label should be in your inbox now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again, I really do appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that was it. You have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
